The owners in the shop

In the old town

Greko Accessories is in the old town of Paphos, a white shop front with the greko sign. The photos show walls full of necklaces and earrings, and according to one review the piercing studio is upstairs. One review says they spent over an hour looking around and the owners were happy to help choose.
